title: Agent Middleware V1
summary: This module provides a collection of middleware components designed to enhance agent functionality by controlling model and tool interactions, managing context, handling PII, and enabling human oversight. It offers features like call limiting, retries, fallbacks, summarization, and secure shell execution.

nodes.label: Agent Core (Model)
nodes.title: Agent Core (Model)
nodes.description: The central language model component of the agent, responsible for reasoning and generating responses based on current state and tools.

nodes.label: Agent Core (Tools)
nodes.title: Agent Core (Tools)
nodes.description: Manages the execution of various tools available to the agent, processing tool calls and their results.

nodes.label: Agent State Management
nodes.title: Agent State Management
nodes.description: Stores and manages the conversational history, internal variables, and other state relevant to the agent's operation and middleware.

nodes.label: Manage Conversation Context
nodes.title: Manage Conversation Context
nodes.description: Prunes messages and tool results to keep the conversation within the language model's token limits, preventing context overflow.

nodes.label: Provide Filesystem Search
nodes.title: Provide Filesystem Search
nodes.description: Integrates tools for searching local filesystem files and their content (Glob, Grep), enabling agents to interact with the local environment.

nodes.label: Enable Human Approval
nodes.title: Enable Human Approval
nodes.description: Allows human users to review and approve, edit, or reject agent's proposed tool calls, ensuring oversight and control.

nodes.label: Enforce Model Call Limits
nodes.title: Enforce Model Call Limits
nodes.description: Monitors and restricts the number of calls made to the language model per thread or run, preventing excessive usage and managing costs.

nodes.label: Handle Model Failovers
nodes.title: Handle Model Failovers
nodes.description: Provides automatic fallback to alternative language models if the primary model call fails, enhancing agent robustness.

nodes.label: Retry Failed Model Calls
nodes.title: Retry Failed Model Calls
nodes.description: Automatically retries language model calls that fail due to transient errors, with configurable backoff strategies.

nodes.label: Detect & Redact PII
nodes.title: Detect & Redact PII
nodes.description: Identifies and processes Personally Identifiable Information (PII) in agent communications, applying redaction, masking, or blocking strategies for privacy.

nodes.label: Stream PII Redaction
nodes.title: Stream PII Redaction
nodes.description: Applies PII redaction rules to streaming agent events and messages in real-time, ensuring PII is scrubbed before reaching consumers.

nodes.label: Provide Persistent Shell
nodes.title: Provide Persistent Shell
nodes.description: Offers a long-lived shell session as a tool for the agent, with various execution policies for secure command execution.

nodes.label: Summarize Conversation History
nodes.title: Summarize Conversation History
nodes.description: Generates summaries of older conversation history to maintain context while staying within token limits, improving efficiency.

nodes.label: Manage Agent Todo List
nodes.title: Manage Agent Todo List
nodes.description: Enables the agent to create and manage structured task lists for complex multi-step operations, improving planning.

nodes.label: Enforce Tool Call Limits
nodes.title: Enforce Tool Call Limits
nodes.description: Monitors and restricts the number of calls made to specific tools or all tools, preventing overuse and managing resource consumption.

nodes.label: Emulate Tools with LLM
nodes.title: Emulate Tools with LLM
nodes.description: Simulates tool execution using a language model instead of actual tool calls, useful for testing and development without real-world side effects.

nodes.label: Retry Failed Tool Calls
nodes.title: Retry Failed Tool Calls
nodes.description: Automatically retries tool calls that fail due to transient errors, with configurable backoff strategies.

nodes.label: Select Relevant Tools
nodes.title: Select Relevant Tools
nodes.description: Uses a language model to intelligently filter and select the most relevant tools for a given user query, optimizing tool usage.

nodes.label: External LLM Service
nodes.title: External LLM Service
nodes.description: Provides language model capabilities for agent reasoning, summarization, tool emulation, and tool selection.

nodes.label: External Filesystem
nodes.title: External Filesystem
nodes.description: Provides access to local files and directories for search and shell operations.

nodes.label: Human User
nodes.title: Human User
nodes.description: Provides input and receives output, and can intervene in agent decisions.

nodes.label: Execution Sandbox
nodes.title: Execution Sandbox
nodes.description: Isolated environment (e.g., Codex CLI, Docker) for secure command execution, used by the shell tool.

groups.label: Agent Core
groups.title: Agent Core
groups.description: The fundamental components of the agent, including its language model for reasoning, tool execution capabilities, and state management.

groups.label: Model Interaction Control
groups.title: Model Interaction Control
groups.description: Middleware components that govern how the agent interacts with language models, including managing call limits, handling failures, and optimizing tool selection.

groups.label: Agent Context & State Management
groups.title: Agent Context & State Management
groups.description: Middleware focused on maintaining and optimizing the agent's conversational context and internal state, such as pruning messages, summarizing history, and managing task lists.

groups.label: Security & External Access
groups.title: Security & External Access
groups.description: Middleware components that handle security concerns like PII detection and redaction, and facilitate secure interaction with external systems like filesystems and human users.

groups.label: Tool Interaction Control
groups.title: Tool Interaction Control
groups.description: Middleware components that manage and control the agent's use of tools, including enforcing call limits, retrying failed calls, and emulating tool behavior.
